# TUI (TaeinUI): Full API Reference

> A React + TypeScript UI component library where each component carries its own motion.
> GSAP is the motion runtime (21 components today); visibility, legibility and readability
> are never traded for it. Zero-runtime CSS via Vanilla Extract, tree-shakable, WCAG 2.2 AA.
> Runtime dependencies: @vanilla-extract/css, @vanilla-extract/recipes, clsx, gsap.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @taein-ui/core
# or
pnpm add @taein-ui/core
```

## Setup

```tsx
// main.tsx
import '@taein-ui/core/styles.css';

function App() {
  return <YourApp />;
}
```

## API Patterns

UI components follow consistent patterns:
- `variant`: Visual style (e.g., 'primary' | 'dark' | 'light')
- `size`: Component size ('sm' | 'md' | 'lg')
- `disabled`: Disabled state (boolean)
- `className`: Additional CSS class (string)
- `ref`: All components support forwardRef
- Form components require `label` prop for accessibility

Motion components (HangulAssemble, BrushText, CopyButton, BurstToggle, HoldButton, SloshGauge, RocketButton, LuminousFlow) take only `className` and `ref` (and `disabled` where it applies). They have no `size` or `variant`. GooeySearch is the exception: it is a controlled input with its own props. CopyButton also takes `value` and its label props. BurstToggle also takes `selected`, `selectedIcon` and a required `aria-label`. HoldButton also takes a required `onConfirm` and `confirmLabel`. SloshGauge also takes a required `value` and `label`, plus `min`, `max`, `valueText` and `paused`. FanMenu also takes a required `label` and `items` (2 to 8 `{ icon, label, onSelect }`). RocketButton also takes `sentLabel`, `container` and `smoke`. LuminousFlow is a background that fills its parent box: it takes `paused` and no other props. CodeSlots is a form component, not a plain motion one: it takes a required `label` like the other form components, plus `length`, `value`, `defaultValue`, `onChange`, `onComplete`, `helperText`, `error`, `errorMessage`, `success` and `successMessage`.

---

## TextField

Text input with label, validation, and helper text.

```tsx
import { TextField } from '@taein-ui/core';

<TextField
  label="이메일"
  type="email"
  placeholder="example@email.com"
  value={value}
  onChange={(e) => setValue(e.target.value)}
  error={!isValid}
  errorMessage="올바른 이메일을 입력하세요"
  helperText="회사 이메일을 입력해주세요"
  size="md"
  fullWidth
  required
/>

// 여러 줄: multiline을 켠다 (textarea). rows는 보이는 줄 수, autoResize는 내용에 맞춰 높이가 늘어난다
<TextField label="소개" multiline rows={4} />
<TextField label="메모" multiline autoResize />
```

### Props (extends InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>, multiline이면 TextareaHTMLAttributes<HTMLTextAreaElement>)
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| label | string | (required) | Label text |
| type | 'text' \| 'email' \| 'password' \| 'number' \| 'tel' \| 'url' | 'text' | Input type |
| multiline | boolean | false | Render a `textarea`. `ref` is then `HTMLTextAreaElement`, and `type` is not accepted |
| rows | number | 4 | Visible lines. Only with `multiline` (a type error otherwise) |
| autoResize | boolean | false | Grow to fit the content. Only with `multiline` (a type error otherwise) |
| size | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' | 'md' | Input size |
| error | boolean | false | Error state |
| errorMessage | string | - | Error message |
| success | boolean | false | Success state. Border and message turn `color.success.dark`. `error` wins when both are true |
| successMessage | string | - | Success message, shown in the helper text's place while `success` is true |
| helperText | string | - | Helper text |
| fullWidth | boolean | false | Full width |
| required | boolean | - | Required attribute |
| disabled | boolean | - | Disabled attribute |
| className | string | - | Additional CSS class |

The input shakes left and right once, and turns red, whenever `error` goes from false to true or `errorMessage` changes while `error` stays true (not on first render). To shake again for the same mistake, change `errorMessage` or toggle `error`. The message drops in from 4px above. Reduced motion: no shake, color only.

### Accessibility
- `aria-invalid` set automatically when `error` is true (not for `success`)
- `aria-describedby` linked to helper/error/success text
- Label always connected via `htmlFor`/`id`
- `multiline` has no `height` prop: use `rows`, or `style={{ minHeight: 200 }}` for a pixel height
- Write `multiline` as a `true`/`false` literal. For a variable, split with a ternary (`flag ? <TextField multiline /> : <TextField />`), and type a wrapper's props as `ComponentProps<typeof TextField>`. Toggling `multiline` swaps the element, so it remounts (focus and uncontrolled value are lost)

---

## Checkbox

Checkbox with label and indeterminate state support.

```tsx
import { Checkbox } from '@taein-ui/core';

<Checkbox
  label="약관에 동의합니다"
  checked={checked}
  onChange={(e) => setChecked(e.target.checked)}
  size="md"
/>

// Indeterminate
<Checkbox label="전체 선택" indeterminate={isPartial} />
```

### Props (extends InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>)
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| label | string | (required) | Label text |
| size | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' | 'md' | Checkbox size |
| error | boolean | false | Error state |
| errorMessage | string | - | Error message |
| helperText | string | - | Helper text |
| indeterminate | boolean | false | Indeterminate state |
| required | boolean | - | Required attribute |
| disabled | boolean | - | Disabled attribute |
| className | string | - | Additional CSS class |

### Focus
Keyboard focus (`:focus-visible`) shows on the box's own border, not an outer ring. Unchecked turns the border `primary`. Checked and indeterminate already have a `primary` fill and border, so the border turns `primary[900]` (8.63:1 against the page) with a white 2px band just inside it (4.60:1 against the fill). `error` wins: the border stays red and 2px more is added inside (white on a checked box) so focus still shows.

---

## Switch

Toggle switch with label.

```tsx
import { Switch } from '@taein-ui/core';

<Switch
  label="알림 받기"
  checked={enabled}
  onChange={(e) => setEnabled(e.target.checked)}
  size="md"
/>
```

### Props (extends InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>)
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| label | string | (required) | Label text |
| size | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' | 'md' | Switch size |
| error | boolean | false | Error state |
| errorMessage | string | - | Error message |
| helperText | string | - | Helper text |
| required | boolean | - | Required attribute |
| disabled | boolean | - | Disabled attribute |
| className | string | - | Additional CSS class |

### Focus
Keyboard focus (`:focus-visible`) shows on the track's own edge, not an outer ring. Off turns the 2px edge `primary`. On has a `primary` fill already, so the edge becomes two inner bands: `primary[900]` 2px with a white 2px just inside it. `error` wins: the edge stays red and 2px more is added inside (white when on) so focus still shows.

---

## Slider

Range slider with marks and value display.

```tsx
import { Slider } from '@taein-ui/core';

<Slider
  label="볼륨"
  min={0}
  max={100}
  step={5}
  value={volume}
  onChange={(e) => setVolume(Number(e.target.value))}
  showValue
  marks={[{ value: 0, label: '0' }, { value: 100, label: '100' }]}
/>

<Slider label="밝기" variant="bar" value={v} onChange={(e) => setV(Number(e.target.value))} />
<Slider label="재생 위치" variant="wake" value={v} onChange={(e) => setV(Number(e.target.value))} />
```

### Props (extends InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>)
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| label | string | (required) | Label text |
| variant | 'default' \| 'bar' \| 'wake' | 'default' | Look. `default` and `bar` draw the line as one SVG shape that swells around the thumb in proportion to drag speed (6px up to 20px, longer behind the thumb) and goes smooth again when still. `bar` has no visible thumb (the fill bar is the value, focus turns the line's own border dark `primary` and thicker). `wake` splits the line into tick bars (one per 8px of track width, 8 to 160) that ripple behind the thumb in proportion to its speed (no ripple under reduced motion) |
| min | number | 0 | Minimum value |
| max | number | 100 | Maximum value |
| step | number | 1 | Step increment |
| showValue | boolean | false | Display current value |
| showThumbValue | boolean | false | Show the value above the thumb while grabbing or dragging. Off by default. It sits at the label and `showValue` line height, so it can overlap them when the thumb is at either end |
| helperText | string | - | Helper text |
| marks | { value: number; label: string }[] | - | Marks on track |
| trackColor | string | - | Fill track color |
| value | number | - | Controlled value |
| defaultValue | number | 0 | Initial value (uncontrolled) |
| disabled | boolean | - | Disabled attribute |
| className | string | - | Additional CSS class |

### Focus
Keyboard focus (`:focus-visible`) shows on the control's own border, not an outer ring. `default` and `wake`: the thumb's `primary` border goes from 2px to 4px. `bar` (no thumb): the line's border thickens to 3px and turns `primary[900]`.

---

## NumericSpinner

Number input with increment/decrement buttons.

```tsx
import { NumericSpinner } from '@taein-ui/core';

<NumericSpinner
  label="수량"
  value={qty}
  onChange={setQty}
  min={1}
  max={99}
  step={1}
  size="md"
/>
```

### Props (extends InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>)
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| label | string | (required) | Label text |
| value | number | - | Controlled value |
| defaultValue | number | - | Initial value (uncontrolled) |
| size | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' | 'md' | Input size |
| min | number | - | Minimum value |
| max | number | - | Maximum value |
| step | number | 1 | Increment step (rounded to the longer of the decimals of `step` and of the current value, so 0.1 three times is 0.3 and 0.25 + 0.1 is 0.35) |
| error | boolean | false | Error state |
| errorMessage | string | - | Error message |
| helperText | string | - | Helper text |
| fullWidth | boolean | false | Full width |
| required | boolean | - | Required attribute |
| disabled | boolean | - | Disabled attribute |
| className | string | - | Additional CSS class |

The input is not read-only. The user can type a number; while typing the field may be empty or out of range, and the value is committed on blur and Enter (clamped to `min`/`max`; an empty or non-numeric field reverts to the previous value; `onChange` is not called when the committed value equals the previous one). ArrowUp/ArrowDown change the value by `step`. For a custom input width use `style={{ width: '60px' }}`.

### Focus
Focus (`:focus`, a mouse click too) turns the number box's border `primary`, like TextField, with no outer ring. `error` wins over focus. The `+`/`-` buttons keep their `:focus-visible` outline ring for now.

---

## Button

Primary action button with variants, loading, and icons.

```tsx
import { Button } from '@taein-ui/core';
import { Plus } from 'lucide-react';

<Button variant="primary" size="md" onClick={handleClick}>
  저장하기
</Button>

<Button variant="dark" buttonStyle="weak" leftIcon={<Plus />}>
  추가
</Button>

<Button loading disabled>처리 중...</Button>
```

### Props (extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>)
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| variant | 'primary' \| 'dark' \| 'danger' \| 'light' | 'primary' | Button variant |
| buttonStyle | 'strong' \| 'weak' | 'strong' | strong: solid background, weak: light background |
| size | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl' | 'md' | Button size |
| fullWidth | boolean | false | Stretch to full width |
| loading | boolean | false | Show loading spinner |
| disabled | boolean | false | Disable button |
| leftIcon | ReactNode | - | Icon before text |
| rightIcon | ReactNode | - | Icon after text |
| customColor | { bg: string; text: string; hoverBg?: string; activeBg?: string } | - | Custom colors |
| children | ReactNode | - | Button text |
| className | string | - | Additional CSS class |

### Accessibility
- `aria-disabled` set when disabled or loading
- `aria-busy` set when loading
- `aria-hidden="true"` on decorative icons

---

## IconButton

Turns an icon from any icon library into a button. Pass an icon from lucide-react,
react-icons or similar as `children`; the button `size` decides the icon size
(the icon's `svg` is set to `1em`, and `className` or `style` on the icon win).
A consumer's global element rule (for example `svg { width: 24px }`) beats it, while a class or `style` still wins.
Requires `aria-label` for accessibility.

Note: lucide's `size` prop is an SVG attribute, so the button's CSS rule overrides it.
To change the size, pass `className` or `style` to the icon.

```tsx
import { IconButton } from '@taein-ui/core';
import { Plus, X } from 'lucide-react';

// buttonStyle 기본값은 ghost(배경 없음)
// Jelly hover is on by default: the icon spreads sideways when the mouse enters, then wobbles back
<IconButton aria-label="메뉴">
  <Plus />
</IconButton>

<IconButton buttonStyle="strong" variant="primary" aria-label="닫기" onClick={handleClose}>
  <X />
</IconButton>

// Turn it off with hoverEffect="none" (hoverEffect="jelly" is the default)
<IconButton hoverEffect="none" aria-label="메뉴">
  <Plus />
</IconButton>
```

### Props (extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>)
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| variant | 'primary' \| 'dark' \| 'danger' \| 'light' | 'primary' | Button variant. Applies to weak and strong only (ghost is gray) |
| buttonStyle | 'ghost' \| 'weak' \| 'strong' | 'ghost' | ghost: no background, weak: light background, strong: solid background |
| size | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl' | 'md' | Button size. `sm` looks 36px but the press area stays 44px (an invisible band around it) |
| hoverEffect | 'none' \| 'jelly' | 'jelly' | On by default; set "none" to turn it off. jelly: when the mouse enters, the icon spreads sideways (scaleX 1.15, scaleY 1/1.15, volume kept) and wobbles back with a spring. Only the icon moves, not the button. Re-entry while it is running is ignored. Mouse only (no effect for touch or keyboard focus, disabled or loading); with reduced motion nothing moves. Works in all three buttonStyles |
| loading | boolean | false | Loading state |
| disabled | boolean | false | Disabled state |
| children | ReactNode | - | Icon content |
| aria-label | string | - | Required accessibility label |
| className | string | - | Additional CSS class |

---

## SegmentedButtons

Button group for single selection.

```tsx
import { SegmentedButtons } from '@taein-ui/core';

<SegmentedButtons
  options={[
    { value: 'list', label: '목록' },
    { value: 'grid', label: '그리드' },
    { value: 'map', label: '지도' },
  ]}
  value={view}
  onChange={setView}
  size="md"
  aria-label="보기 방식"
/>
```

### Props
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| options | { value: string; label: string; icon?: ReactNode; iconOnly?: boolean; disabled?: boolean }[] | (required) | Button options |
| value | string | - | Selected value (controlled) |
| onChange | (value: string) => void | - | Change handler |
| defaultValue | string | - | Initial value (uncontrolled) |
| size | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' | 'md' | Size. `sm` is 36px tall but the press area stays 44px (an invisible band above and below) |
| fullWidth | boolean | false | Full width |
| disabled | boolean | false | Disable all buttons |
| aria-label | string | - | Group name. Either `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby` is required (type error otherwise) |
| aria-labelledby | string | - | Id of the element that names the group. Alternative to `aria-label` |
| className | string | - | Additional CSS class |

### Focus
Keyboard focus (`:focus-visible`, not a mouse click) draws a 2px `primary` border on the track's own edge, not an outer ring. Focus follows the selected option (arrow keys move the selection), which already has a `primary` fill, so the border goes around the whole track.

---

## Badge

Status or count indicator.

```tsx
import { Badge } from '@taein-ui/core';

<Badge variant="primary">5</Badge>
<Badge variant="error" max={99}>150</Badge>
<Badge dot />
```

### Props (extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>)
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| children | ReactNode | - | Badge content |
| variant | 'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'success' \| 'error' \| 'warning' | 'primary' | Badge variant |
| size | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' | 'md' | Badge size |
| max | number | 99 | Maximum value |
| dot | boolean | false | Dot mode |
| className | string | - | Additional CSS class |
| aria-label | string | - | Accessible name of a `dot` (adds role="img"), or use it together with `role`. Without a name or `role`, a dot is `aria-hidden`. Text badges are named by their text |

No default `role`. Text is the accessible name. Pass `role="status"` or `aria-live` to make it a live region. When the number decreases the old value leaves downward.

---

## Chip

Tag or filter chip.

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Chip } from '@taein-ui/core';

const [tags, setTags] = useState(['React', 'Vite']);

<Chip label="React" />
{tags.map((tag) => (
  <Chip
    key={tag}
    label={tag}
    onDelete={() => setTags((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t !== tag))}
  />
))}
<Chip label="선택됨" selected onClick={() => {}} />
```

### Props
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| label | string | (required) | Chip label |
| size | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' | 'md' | Chip size |
| variant | 'filled' \| 'outlined' | 'filled' | Chip variant |
| color | 'default' \| 'primary' \| 'success' \| 'error' \| 'warning' | 'default' | Color |
| icon | ReactNode | - | Leading icon |
| avatar | ReactNode | - | Avatar element |
| onDelete | () => void | - | Delete callback. Called after the exit animation ends (not called if the chip unmounts during the exit); if you do not remove the chip from your list it stays in place, invisible |
| selected | boolean | - | Selected state. On a chip with `onClick`, passing it makes the chip a toggle (`aria-pressed`); omit it for a non-toggle chip. Without `onClick` it only styles the chip as selected (no `aria-pressed`) |
| disabled | boolean | false | Disabled state |
| onClick | () => void | - | Click handler. Passing it makes the chip a pressable `<button>` (no `clickable` prop). With `onDelete` the chip is a `<div>` holding the action `<button>` and the delete `<button>` side by side |
| className | string | - | Additional CSS class |

### Focus
Keyboard focus (`:focus-visible`) draws a 2px border in the chip's own edge (inside it, never an outer ring): `primary`; on a filled `primary`/`success`/`error`/`warning` chip it is `primary[900]` (plus a white 2px band just inside it on `primary` and `error` faces, which the dark band alone does not separate). A selected chip already has a ring marker, so its focus border is 4px. The delete button keeps its `:focus-visible` outline ring for now.

---

## Avatar

User avatar with image, fallback, and status indicator.

```tsx
import { Avatar, AvatarGroup } from '@taein-ui/core';

<Avatar src="/photo.jpg" alt="사용자" size="lg" status="online" />
<Avatar alt="홍길동">홍</Avatar>

<AvatarGroup max={3} size="md">
  <Avatar src="/a.jpg" alt="A" />
  <Avatar src="/b.jpg" alt="B" />
  <Avatar src="/c.jpg" alt="C" />
  <Avatar src="/d.jpg" alt="D" />
</AvatarGroup>
```

### AvatarProps
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| src | string | - | Image URL |
| alt | string | (required) | Alt text |
| size | 'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl' | 'md' | Avatar size |
| variant | 'circular' \| 'rounded' \| 'square' | 'circular' | Border style |
| status | 'loading' \| 'done' \| 'error' | 'loading' | All types. Bar fills or shakes without icons; spinner closes its ring then pops a check or X; other types form a check or X; returns to its loop on loading. Success uses success.dark, failure error.main. Reduced motion shows final states immediately |
| children | ReactNode | - | Fallback content |
| onClick | () => void | - | Click handler |
| href | string | - | Link URL |
| bouncy | boolean | false | Springy float on hover/keyboard focus and a press scale-up. Static by default. Only works when onClick or href is set. No movement under prefers-reduced-motion |
| onError | () => void | - | Image error callback |
| className | string | - | Additional CSS class |

### AvatarGroupProps
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| children | ReactNode | (required) | Avatar components |
| max | number | - | Max visible avatars |
| size | 'xs' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl' | - | Avatar size |
| spacing | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' | 'md' | Overlap spacing |
| className | string | - | Additional CSS class |

---

## Loader

Loading indicator with orbit (default), spinner, dots, bar or wave variants.

The bar track is a borderless 6px gray (`palette.gray[200]`) surface with 3px rounded ends. Spinner closes its arc then pops its check or X from scale 0.6 at the center using snap for transform and settle for opacity; dots jump to vertices; bar fills green on success or shakes red on failure without icons; wave folds from a horizontal line. The moving blue head of every type has a soft glow (`0 0 6px`, 45% of the head's own color), and it stays under reduced motion.

```tsx
import { Loader } from '@taein-ui/core';

<Loader size="md" />
<Loader type="spinner" size="md" />
<Loader type="dots" label="로딩 중..." />
<Loader type="wave" />
<Loader status="done" label="Saved" />
<Loader type="dots" status="error" />
<Loader fullScreen overlay />
```

The status region carries no `aria-busy` (a busy live region may defer its updates, so the hidden message could be read late or never). To say "this area is loading", put `aria-busy` on the element that wraps the Loader, as with Skeleton. An `aria-busy` passed to Loader itself is dropped.

### Props (extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>)
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| type | 'orbit' \| 'spinner' \| 'dots' \| 'bar' \| 'wave' | 'orbit' | Loader type |
| status | 'loading' \| 'done' \| 'error' | 'loading' | All types. Bar fills or shakes without icons; spinner closes its ring then pops a check or X; other types form a check or X; returns to its loop on loading. Success uses success.dark, failure error.main. Reduced motion shows final states immediately |
| size | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl' | 'md' | Loader size |
| color | 'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'white' \| string | 'primary' | Color preset or any CSS color value (e.g. '#f00', 'currentColor') |
| label | string | - | Text label. Changing the text cross-fades with a blur. When the accessible name equals the label (no `aria-label`, or the same text) the visible label is `aria-hidden` so it is read once through the hidden message in the status region |
| fullScreen | boolean | false | Full screen overlay |
| overlay | boolean | false | Semi-transparent overlay |
| aria-label | string | - | Accessibility label |
| className | string | - | Additional CSS class |

---

## Skeleton

Content placeholder with animation.

```tsx
import { Skeleton } from '@taein-ui/core';

<Skeleton variant="text" width="80%" />
<Skeleton variant="rect" width={200} height={150} />
<Skeleton variant="circle" width={48} height={48} />
```

### Props (extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>)
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| variant | 'text' \| 'rect' \| 'circle' \| 'rounded' | 'text' | Shape variant |
| animation | 'wave' \| 'pulse' \| false | 'wave' | Animation type |
| width | number \| string | - | Width |
| height | number \| string | - | Height |
| aria-label | string | - | Optional. Without it (and without `role`) the Skeleton is `aria-hidden`. With it, `aria-hidden` is dropped and `role="img"` is added so it is the accessible name (a `role` you pass wins) |
| className | string | - | Additional CSS class |

A Skeleton is decoration: `aria-hidden="true"`, no `role`, `aria-live`, `aria-busy` or automatic name. Announce loading on the wrapping region instead, once for the whole group, and remove its `aria-busy` when loading ends:

```tsx
<section aria-busy="true" aria-label="Loading profile">
  <Skeleton variant="circle" width={48} />
  <Skeleton variant="text" width="60%" />
</section>
```

---

## Snackbar

Toast notification with auto-hide. success and warning use the `dark` surface with white (`text.inverse`) text.

Snackbars that are open at the same `position` stack automatically instead of overlapping: the newest sits at the screen edge (bottom or top), older ones are pushed inward with a `spacing[2]` gap. At most 3 per position. When a 4th opens, the oldest one's `onClose` is called, so a Snackbar without `onClose` is never evicted. Stacking is the default. `stack={false}` keeps a Snackbar alone at its position: when it opens, the other Snackbars at that position are closed (each `onClose`), and when any Snackbar opens at that position while it is open, it is the one that gets closed (the newer wins). Give every Snackbar `stack={false}` to show one at a time, each new one replacing the previous.

```tsx
import { Snackbar, Button } from '@taein-ui/core';

<Snackbar
  open={open}
  message="저장되었습니다"
  severity="success"
  position="bottom-right"
  autoHideDuration={3000}
  onClose={() => setOpen(false)}
  action={<Button size="sm" variant="light">취소</Button>}
/>
```

### Props (extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>)
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| open | boolean | (required) | Visibility state |
| message | ReactNode | (required) | Message content |
| severity | 'success' \| 'error' \| 'warning' \| 'info' | 'info' | Message type |
| position | 'top-left' \| 'top-center' \| 'top-right' \| 'bottom-left' \| 'bottom-center' \| 'bottom-right' | 'bottom-right' | Position |
| autoHideDuration | number \| null | 6000 | Auto-close duration (ms) |
| stack | boolean | true | If false, stays alone at its position: closes the others when it opens, and is closed when another opens there |
| onClose | () => void | - | Close callback. Also called when the oldest of 4 stacked Snackbars at one position is evicted, or when `stack={false}` closes it |
| action | ReactNode | - | Action content |
| className | string | - | Additional CSS class |

---

## Tooltip

Hover tooltip with arrow.

```tsx
import { Tooltip, Button } from '@taein-ui/core';

<Tooltip content="도움말 텍스트" position="top">
  <Button>호버하세요</Button>
</Tooltip>
```

### Props (extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>)
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| children | ReactElement | (required) | Single trigger element. aria-describedby is attached to it directly. Received aria-* and onClick are forwarded to it, so a Tooltip can sit inside a Popover |
| content | ReactNode | (required) | Tooltip content |
| open | boolean | - | Controlled visibility |
| onOpenChange | (open: boolean) => void | - | State change callback |
| position | 'top' \| 'bottom' \| 'left' \| 'right' | 'top' | Position |
| delay | number | 200 | Show delay (ms). Skipped while another tooltip is open or closed within 300ms |
| disabled | boolean | false | Disable tooltip |
| arrow | boolean | true | Show arrow |
| className | string | - | Additional CSS class |

## Modal

Dialog modal with compound components.

열 때 포커스된 요소(또는 기존 `triggerRef`)의 사각형·둥글기·배경색을 이어받아 창으로 자란다. 요소는 숨기고, `slower` 동안 `settle`로 창이 다 자란 뒤 내용을 `slow`로 페이드인한다. 닫으면 내용이 먼저 사라지고 요소의 현재 사각형·색으로 돌아간 뒤 visibility와 포커스를 복원한다. container의 transform 배율도 좌표에 반영한다. 요소가 없거나 화면 밖이면 가운데 등장으로 대체한다. 축소 모션에서는 요소를 숨기지 않고 즉시 표시한다. API 변경은 없다.

```tsx
import { Modal, Button } from '@taein-ui/core';

// Compound API
<Modal open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} size="md">
  <Modal.Header showClose>
    <Modal.Title>제목</Modal.Title>
  </Modal.Header>
  <Modal.Content>
    <p>모달 내용입니다.</p>
  </Modal.Content>
  <Modal.Footer align="right">
    <Button variant="light" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>취소</Button>
    <Button variant="primary" onClick={handleSave}>저장</Button>
  </Modal.Footer>
</Modal>

// Flat API
<Modal open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} title="제목" showClose footer={<Button>확인</Button>}>
  <p>내용</p>
</Modal>
```

### ModalProps (extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>)
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| open | boolean | (required) | Visibility state |
| onClose | () => void | (required) | Close handler |
| children | ReactNode | (required) | Modal content |
| size | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'xl' \| 'full' | 'md' | Modal size |
| closeOnBackdropClick | boolean | true | Close on backdrop click |
| closeOnEscape | boolean | true | Close on ESC key |
| container | HTMLElement \| null | document.body | 그릴 DOM 위치. 주면 body 스크롤을 잠그지 않는다. 그 안에 갇히려면 container에 `contain: layout` 또는 `transform` |
| triggerRef | RefObject<HTMLElement \| null> | - | 안 주면 열 때 포커스된 요소에서 자란다. Safari·Firefox(macOS)는 버튼 클릭에 포커스를 주지 않아 가운데에서 열린다. 주면 모든 브라우저에서 그 요소 자리에서 자란다. |
| title | string | - | Title (Flat mode) |
| showClose | boolean | false | Show close button (Flat mode) |
| footer | ReactNode | - | Footer (Flat mode) |
| footerAlign | 'left' \| 'center' \| 'right' | 'left' | Footer alignment |
| aria-label | string | - | Accessibility label |
| className | string | - | Additional CSS class |

### Compound Components

간단하면 prop(`title`·`footer`), 직접 꾸미려면 조합(`Modal.Header` 등)을 쓴다. 하위 컴포넌트는 `Modal.Header`처럼 점 표기로만 접근한다(`ModalHeader` 같은 최상위 export는 없다).

- `Modal.Header`: Header container. Props: showClose
- `Modal.Title`: Heading. Props: as ('h1'-'h6', default 'h2')
- `Modal.Content`: Scrollable content area
- `Modal.Footer`: Footer. Props: align ('left' | 'center' | 'right')

### Accessibility
- `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`
- Focus trap (Tab cycles within modal)
- ESC key closes modal
- Focus restoration after the closing animation and trigger visibility restoration

---

<BottomSheet open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} height="md" enableDrag>

| title | ReactNode | - | Sheet title |

| showHandle | boolean | true | Show drag handle |

### Compound Components

## Card

Content container with compound components.

```tsx
import { Card } from '@taein-ui/core';

// Compound API
<Card variant="elevated">
  <Card.Image src="/photo.jpg" alt="설명" />
  <Card.Header>
    <Card.Title>카드 제목</Card.Title>
  </Card.Header>
  <Card.Body>
    <p>카드 내용입니다.</p>
  </Card.Body>
  <Card.Footer>
    <Button size="sm">자세히</Button>
  </Card.Footer>
</Card>

// 클릭 가능한 카드 (기본으로는 떠오르지 않는다)
<Card onClick={handleClick}>
  <Card.Body padding="lg">클릭 가능한 카드</Card.Body>
</Card>

// 마우스를 올리면 떠오르는 카드 (선택)
<Card variant="outlined" hoverLift onClick={handleClick}>
  <Card.Body padding="lg">떠오르는 카드</Card.Body>
</Card>
```

### CardProps (extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>)
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| children | ReactNode | (required) | Content |
| variant | 'outlined' \| 'elevated' \| 'filled' | 'elevated' | Card variant |
| onClick | () => void | - | Click handler |
| disabled | boolean | false | Disable interactivity |
| hoverLift | boolean | false | Lift and deepen the shadow on hover, press down briefly on press (lift is mouse only, off when disabled) |
| title | string | - | Title (Flat mode) |
| image | string | - | Image URL (Flat mode) |
| imageAlt | string | '' | Image alt text (Flat mode) |
| padding | 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' | 'md' | Body padding (Flat mode) |
| className | string | - | Additional CSS class |

### Compound Components

간단하면 prop(`title`·`footer`·`image`), 직접 꾸미려면 조합(`Card.Body` 등)을 쓴다. 하위 컴포넌트는 `Card.Body`처럼 점 표기로만 접근한다(`CardBody` 같은 최상위 export는 없다).

- `Card.Image`: Image container. Props: src, alt, children (overlay)
- `Card.ImageOverlay`: `Card.Image` 안에 얹는 오버레이
- `Card.Header`: Header area
- `Card.Title`: Heading. Props: as ('h1'-'h6', default 'h3')
- `Card.Body`: Body area. Props: padding
- `Card.Footer`: Footer area

## Border

### Props (extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>)
| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| children | ReactNode | (required) | Content |
| sides | 'all' \| 'top' \| 'right' \| 'bottom' \| 'left' \| 'horizontal' \| 'vertical' | 'all' | Border sides |
| variant | 'solid' \| 'dashed' \| 'dotted' | 'solid' | Border style |

| color | 'default' \| 'primary' \| 'success' \| 'error' \| 'warning' | 'default' | Border color |
| rounded | 'none' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'full' | 'md' if sides='all', else 'none' | Border radius. An explicit value always wins |
| padding | 'none' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' | 'none' | Inner padding |
| glow | boolean | false | A single light with a fixed 48px fading tail follows the rounded perimeter, one lap per 3000ms with two slow-fast-slow segments, regardless of hover or focus. Only with sides='all'. It moves for more than 5 seconds (WCAG 2.2.2), so turn it off when loading ends. Reduced motion: the light stays at the start |
| className | string | - | Additional CSS class |
